book.name: MATAIYO
book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Mataiyo wana Leleli

content: Yeisu Iya Sabwata ana Babala
Saugena o elana, Sabwata etegana Yeisu i nosola witi ana eyowa etega gamwanaa. Wana tohago hi galebu inoke witi enona hi lokibwaan ge hi an.
Sauga Palisi hi kitel, inoke hi baek Yeisu elana hi ba, “U kite, wam tohago Sabwata ana logugui hi leke.”
Yeisu analiya i lahe i ba, “Age Deibid liwanina nige ku vavasili ga, ga i ginol ola sauga alonau ge alonau hi galebu?

He Deibid i na i ulutuk Yehoba wana limiya inoke beleid bwabwalena toto hi teliya Yehoba manininaa, topowon i ahe i pek Deibid ge alonau elal ge hi an. Beleid o hi an, bwagana logugui i ba tage bahi nihi aan, topowon ya te nihi an.
Age Mosese wana Logugui nige ku vavasili ga, toto i ba topowon Sabwata maisena ge maisena nihi tuwatuwalali limi bwabwalena elana? He Sabwata ana logugui iyaka hi leke to, yaa nige wali nak i gagan.
Na baewa eliyamiu, gamagal etega iyahe te, iya limi bwabwalena alana i bwata lake.

Yehoba wana baaba etega ana sapu nige ku aatena, toto i ba, ‘Nau nuwau atilomwan paganina, nige nuwau bwasumu powopowonina.’ Binimala baaba ya ana sapu nuku atena, he no tohago nige nuku aawa naknakagil, heliya nige wali nak i gagan.
Kaiwena nau Gamagal Natuna, nau Sabwata ana Babala.”
Sabwataa Yeisu Tau Nimana Alialigana I Pwamolu
Yeisu i nawanawa al i na i ulutuk panuwa o wali limi tapwalolowa.

Tau etega iyoho to, nimana labi etega i aliga. Palisi nuwaliya Yeisu ana woliwoli nihi ginol, inoke hi neli hi ba, “Wala logugui ga i ba ola? I bosowaina ya gamagal etega ta pwamolu lan Sabwataa o nigeya?”
Yaka i baek elal i ba, “Komiu etega, ebo wana sipi etega i gan ge lan Sabwataa ni soguek gola, nasi ni pihikan ge ni momol heyan, age?
He sipi bugul bwabwatana, yaa gamagal bugul bwabwatana hot. Inoke Logugui i talam ginol waiwaisana ta ginol lan Sabwataa.”
Yaka i baek tau o elana i ba, “Nimwam u paelu.” Inoke nimana i paelu, ge nimana iyaka i waisi i ola nimana labuina.
Yaa Palisi hi tagil, hi na hi nuwanuwatu ga nihi ginol ola ge Yeisu nihi lopaaliga.
Yeisu Iya Yehoba wana Totuwalali
Palisi wali nuwatu Yeisu i atena inoke panuwa o i eguluwai. Gamagalau hi gewi hi toulil ge wali tokasiyebwa gegewel i pwamolol,
yaa i lopwalil bahi nihi wawasaan te henala iya.
He i ginol ola to, inoke Yehoba wana baaba toto palopita Aiseya i pamasal i tabwa tunahot, i ba:

content.text: No totuwalali hiwe, toto ya hile,
ge iya no logugui sasapona ni wasaan gamagalau gegewel elal.
Nige ni aawabalgig ge nige ni yogayoga,
Kaliyou toto i kom nige ni pipigabom,
odam toto i tolau nige ni pwapwabolu.
He i ola al gamagalau bolo yayaluwaliya i pweyata nige ni totowaagil.
Ni tuwalali ana siga Yehoba wana logugui sasapona bugul gegewena ni lake.
Iya alana elana gamagalau gegewel mel nihi teli.

content: Palisi Hi Ba Tage Yeisu wana Gasisi I Neem Seitani elana
Gamagalau enuna tau etega hi pwatanim, matana i kai ge nige bosowaina ni baaba, kaiwena yayaluwa bibikena i holaviya elana. Yeisu i pwamolu inoke anana i mwapwela ge matana i panana.
Yaka gamagalau gegewel nuwaliya hi ahe ge hi ba, “Bi ola ge iya Deibid Tubuna?”
Yaa sauga Palisi hi hago yaka hi ba, “Yayaluwa bibikel wali tohouwa, Tamudulele, wana gasisi elana te yayaluwa bibikel i papatuna owaowa-agil.”

Wali nuwatu Yeisu i atena inoke i baek elal i ba, “Ebo abalogugui etega boda ni palabui ge totoliya nihi lohaveyan, he abalogugui o nasi ni mowasi. Ge ebo panuwa etega o ebo un etega boda ni palabui ge totoliya nihi lohaveyan, he nasi nige ni gagasisi.
I ola al, ebo Seitani totona wana boda ni patuna owaowa-agil, he totoliya hi lohaveyan elal to, inoke wana abalogugui ni mowasi.

Ku ba tage Tamudulele wana gasisi elana yayaluwa bibikel ya papatuna owaowa-agil. He ebo ku ba ola o, inoke henala wana gasisi elana ge komiu wami tohago yayaluwa bibikel hi papatuna owaowa-agil? He wami tohago wami gegi nihi pamasal.
Yaa ebo Yehoba Yayaluwana wana gasisi elana ge yayaluwa bibikel ya papatuna owaowa-agil, he Yehoba wana logugui iyaka i nem haba eliyamiu.
“Nige bosowaina gamagal etega ni ulutuk asiyala
wana limiya ge wana gogomwau ni bugulan, age? Ebo nuwana, inoke ni yowan hikan ga, abwe wana limi bugubugulina ni bugul egonan.
“Henala nige i miminaa eliyau, iya o topihigelgel. Henala ebo nige alou ha gogogon pahipahi, iya tolopetaki.

Na baewa eliyamiu, henala ebo pagan nanakina ni ginol ge ebo ni ba bwagabwaga ge Yehoba ni awatautau-an, he bosowaina ya gegi toto o Yehoba ni nuwayoho. Yaa henala ni ba bwagabwaga ge Yayaluwa Bwabwalena ni awatautau-an, he gegi toto o Yehoba nige ni nunuwayoho.

Henala ebo Gamagal Natuna ni ba panapanak-an, he bosowaina ya gegi toto o Yehoba ni nuwayoho. Yaa henala Yayaluwa Bwabwalena ni ba panapanak-an, he gegi toto o Yehoba nige ni nunuwayoho, sauga ya o ebo sauga i nenem.
“Ebo ebwakil waiwaisana, he enona i waisi. Ebo ebwakil nanakina, he enona i nak. Ebo enona ta kite inoke ebwakil ta atena, ebo ebwakil waiwaisana ebo ebwakil nanakina.
Komiu Palisi ku ola mwata! Komiu gamagalau nanakil, inoke nige bosowaina baaba waiwaisana nuku baunan. Nigeya hot! Hauna ebo atela i pakalaopopwi, heiya te i tatagila hohopelaa.
Gamagal toto waiwaisana pagan waiwaisana ni enoni, ni ola waisi toto i pwahin atenaa. Gamagal toto nanakina pagan nanakina ni enoni, ni ola nak toto i pwahin atenaa.
“Na baewa eliyamiu, yatala ana lan elana gamagal maisena ge maisena ana kot ni gan baaba nanakina gegewena kaiwena, toto i baunan.
Ebo wami baaba baaba waiwaisana, Yehoba ni awa wawaisi-agimiu. Ebo wami baaba baaba nanakina, Yehoba ni awa sigasiga-agimiu.”
Palisi Nuwaliya Yeisu Ginol Yawiyawi Etega Ni Ginol Nihi Kite
Inoke Palisi ge Logugui ana topankite enuna hi baek Yeisu elana hi ba, “Topankite, nuwama ginol yawiyawi etega nu ginol naha kite.”

Yeisu analiya i lahe i ba, “Heyan sisigal komiu, nige ku miminaa Yehoba elana, inoke nuwamiu abapankite na ginol eliyamiu. Yaa nige abapankite etega na pepewa, iyai te toto i masala palopita Yona elana.
I ola lan eton ge bulin eton Yona i miminaa moti bwabwatana tinenaa, i ola al lan eton ge bulin eton nau Gamagal Natuna na minaa bilibili gamwanaa.

Lan yatala elana gamagalau Ninibe nihi lut ge nihi awa sigasiga-agimiu, kaiwena Yona wana papaatena hi hago inoke wali gegi ana en hi pek. He gamagal etega iyahe te, iya Yona i bwata lake, yaa komiu nige wana papaatena ku hahago ge nige wami gegi ana en ku pepek.

Lan yatala elana labi Seba wali kwin ni lut ge ni awa sigasiga-agimiu, kaiwena iya i neem labi yayapona elana nuwana Solomon wana panpankiti sisibana ni hago. He gamagal etega iyahe te, iya Solomon i bwata lake, yaa komiu nige anana ku hahago.”
Yayaluwa Bibikena I Ulutagilem Gamagal Etega elana ge I Sikal Al
“Sauga yayaluwa bibikena i ulutagilem gamagal etega elana, inoke i na ula bwagabwaga i tatapainan wana abaveyaho i loya, yaa nige etega i pwapwawa.
Yaka i ba, ‘Na sikal ga abau elana toto ya eguluwai.’ Sauga i sikal, abamina o i kite, hi hala ge hi abubun, yaa enonovana ya.

Inoke i egon i na wana pan yayaluwa bibikel ali gewi seben al i ahel, heliya wali pagan nanakina hot, yaka alonau hi ulutuk ge hi holaviya abamina o elana. Inoke gamagal o wana minamina houhouwena i nak, yaa mulaa i nak nabi hot. He nasi ni masal ni ola to heyan sisigal lan ebe elal.”
Yeisu Hinana ge Talinau Nuwaliya Nihi Kite
Yeisu iyoho i baaba boda elal inoke hinana ge talinau hi vin, hi talmilil noleleya, nuwaliya nihi baaba elana.
Inoke gamagal etega wana wasa i pek, i ba, “Hinam ge talimwau heliya huwo hi taltalmilil noleleya o, nuwaliya nihi baaba elam.”
Anana Yeisu i lahe i ba, “Henala nain, ge henalau taliwau?”
Yaka nimana i huliek wana tohago elal ge i ba, “Nain ge taliwau heliya hiwe!
Henala ebo Nam labulabumwa wana nuwatu ni ginol, iya te taliu, nu ge nain.”

footnotes.text: Mak 3:27 ana epwamwananal paiya nu kite.
